title: New entrant without bespoke code
steps: Deploy two providers with generated identities. Publish roles, enroll one customer, discover a public capability and prepare it locally.
acceptance: No brand branch, funded wallet or central provider registry is needed. Retain manifests, server logs and real local-runtime output.

title: Split-service customer
steps: Bind discovery A, custody B and analytics C for one entity. Read a reserve, prepare a capability plan and export its result.
acceptance: Audience-specific tokens, exact role checks and no cross-provider financial replay. Capture sanitized network boundaries.

title: Institutional custody statement
steps: Ingest a source statement, its duplicate in another feed and a declared authoritative mapping.
acceptance: AUC counts one beneficial position; backing assets and liabilities do not create duplicate customer wealth.

title: Managed reserve mandate
steps: Add an actual test mandate to selected financial positions while leaving other holdings unmanaged.
acceptance: AUM changes only for mandated holdings; AUC and technology coverage stay separate.

title: Business treasury capital loop
steps: Use an existing v1.1 workload comparison to create a reserve allocation. Bring it through the new portfolio instruction interface.
acceptance: Translation drafts, existing committee approves, existing HCP executes, local BTX prepares; no second engine.

title: Family group segregation
steps: Load company, trust and personal books under read-only group access. Adviser prepares a draft for one entity.
acceptance: Principal/entity approval required; no pooling or implicit cross-entity transfers.

title: Whole-portfolio fund view
steps: Represent a real-form synthetic fund interest with partially known underlying reserve exposure.
acceptance: Direct NAV counts parent once; look-through substitutes children with explicit residual coverage.

title: Late source correction
steps: Create month-end report, then ingest a later correction effective at month end.
acceptance: Earlier observation cutoff reproduces old report; new cutoff produces a linked corrected version.

title: Unknown value under outage
steps: Remove one price and one required source while other data remains current.
acceptance: Report partial/unavailable facts instead of zero; no execution authority follows from estimate.

title: Native research commitment
steps: Translate a portfolio research instruction into v1.1 allocation, authorize and use real isolated native funding.
acceptance: Ledger/chain/commitment reconcile; a later refund follows original terms and original provider.

title: Public release to cognitive holding
steps: Fund an actual isolated release fixture, obtain disclosed bytes and prepare a supported local runtime.
acceptance: Financial receipt, right/use record, exact recipe and readiness remain separate.

title: Signed export and hostile import
steps: Export a snapshot to JSONL/CSV, tamper with one chunk, then import the intact set into a second provider.
acceptance: Tampered input rejected, valid import atomically published, original signatures and tenant scope preserved.

title: Desktop analyst journey
steps: Select an asset context in a generic institutional desktop fixture and open its reserve/capability view.
acceptance: Context can read or prepare an explicit draft; no token, trade or runtime execution is embedded.

title: Portfolio technology business
steps: Import several client books for analytics without any management mandate.
acceptance: Coverage and client-specific metrics are reportable; technology vendor AUM is not invented.

title: Reserve and operational shocks
steps: Apply a reserve-price shock and an independent provider-outage shock to a frozen projection.
acceptance: Financial change and operational impacts have distinct units and methodology; local acquired capability survives gateway loss.

title: Concurrency and idempotency
steps: Many agents retry the same instruction while admins revise role/policy state.
acceptance: One exact draft per business operation; changed requests conflict; stale authority does not execute.

title: Scale and cancellation
steps: Run the declared 100k-row process workload and separately the 10m-row institutional lab, with slow readers and cancellation.
acceptance: Correct row counts, bounded memory/disk and measured throughput; unsupported large lab remains explicit.

title: Provider exit with pending capital
steps: Revoke discovery/analytics and move portable records while a native financial child is uncertain.
acceptance: Local use and new read discovery work; original provider reconciles financial child, no duplicated spend.

title: Migration and rollback
steps: Migrate actual v1.1 fixtures, accept v1.2 import/position records, then disable new v1.2 effects.
acceptance: Old contracts/financial recovery and read evidence survive; no Core v4, native ledger or consensus change.

title: Neutral commercial demonstration
steps: Demonstrate the same reserve/portfolio/capability workflow for a full venue, a specialist analytics provider and a greenfield entrant.
acceptance: Same schemas and conformance; fee bases and new external assets are factual and distinct, not inferred from downloads.
